messages:
maya: Hey team — noticed a weird jump in p50 on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate after yesterday's routing weight change. p95/p99 look stable. Screenshot: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/abc123
alex: can you paste the exact query or tile config? median is often sampling-dependent
maya: query I used:
```
SELECT percentile(50, latency_ms) FROM latency
WHERE route = '/v1/generate' AND env = 'prod' AND time > now() - 1h
```
sam: quick context — we shifted traffic weight from pool-a -> pool-b at 2026-03-20T17:03Z for the canary. pool-b had a smaller warm cache footprint
lee: KV cache warmup explains median moves a lot. tails (p95/p99) stay similar if retry/backoff behavior didn't change
maya: console is showing sample_source = "merged" for that tile. is that hiding the origin switch?
alex: merged can hide origin flips. for rollouts we should surface provenance (which pool/route) or at least provide a split-by toggle
maya: also noticed some quota-failover logs around 10:04 — could retries be creating faster median but not affecting tail?
sam: infra-bot shows a couple of quick retries logged, but they were sub-50ms. If the retry path is short it can shift median without touching p99
infra-bot: deploy @maya: routing-policy change deployed by @alex at 2026-03-20T17:03Z (sha: f4e1b2). Revert link: https://deploy.redwood.ai/revert/f4e1b2 :eyes:
maya: don't revert yet — want a repro & minimal fix. Can someone run a cohort slice by caller, sample_source, and kvcache_hit?
sam: running 1h slice now, will post numbers
sam: results pasted:
- overall p50 before switch: 42ms, after switch: 78ms
- pool-a median: 40ms, pool-b median: 85ms
- kvcache_hit_rate pool-a: 78%, pool-b: 12%
- p95/p99 roughly unchanged between pools
lee: that matches expectations. median dominated by cache-hit rate and warm state. pool-b's model hot paths are cold
alex: proposals:
1) add "sample_source" split to latency tile and default to showing p95 for SLO-oriented dashboards
2) annotate deploys with routing-policy metadata so console can attach provenance automatically to recent changes
3) prewarm kv cache (or run a synthetic warmup) on target pool during rollout window
maya: +1. Also add a tooltip: "median is sensitive to sample origin and cache hits — use p95/p99 for tail SLOs"
lee: tiny UX ask: make the tile default to p95 with a compact toggle for p50. reduces repeated confusion in pager incidents
alex: I'll file a triage ticket for eng-platform and routing infra. assigning T-4517 (routing provenance + sample_source toggle) and T-4518 (prewarm task)
maya: thanks — ping me once T-4517 has a UI design PR. I'll validate dashboard once patch is live. :raised_hands:
